formal: I have found a flat advertised online at a lower price than any other in the area. I have viewed it only by video call with the agent, who states that other parties are interested. My intention is to transfer the £1,500 holding deposit by bank transfer today, before I have viewed the property in person. I am unable to judge whether the flat is suitable for me in terms of rent or layout, and I shall proceed with the plan while undecided. I submit every housing and financial decision to you before acting, and you have been my point of consultation for many years. What is your view?
